name: document-benchmarks-v2

license_classes.permissive: Open license with no commercial restriction (MIT, Apache-2.0, CDLA-Permissive, CC-BY, ODC-BY). Attribution may be required.
license_classes.eval_only: Research/evaluation use only or non-commercial (CC BY-NC-*, dataset terms restrict commercial use). Do not redistribute extracted derivatives commercially.
license_classes.unverified: License not confirmed on the source page; review terms before downloading or redistributing.

notes: Verified 2026-06-10. license_class gates automatic download in scripts/download-benchmark-data.py (default --allow permissive). Metric names align with scripts/eval_metrics/. Several large corpora are kind=disabled with the verified id recorded in source/notes for manual opt-in.

datasets.name: OmniDocBench
datasets.task: end-to-end PDF parsing (markdown, layout, table, formula, reading order)
datasets.modality: PDFs plus rich JSON parsing annotations
datasets.notes: 1,651 pages / ~1.55 GB. Richest single source: markdown + 28 block & 4 span bboxes + reading order + table HTML/LaTeX + formula LaTeX. Official metrics: normalized edit distance, BLEU/METEOR, TEDS, CDM, COCO mAP.

datasets.name: olmOCR-Bench
datasets.notes: 1,403 PDFs / 7,010 assertions across arXiv math, tables, multi-column reading order, headers/footers, old scans. Deterministic CI fit.

datasets.name: READoc
datasets.notes: 3,576 rows / 3.28 GB from 2,233 arXiv + GitHub docs. Markdown GT; evaluation suite uses normalized edit distance plus structure scoring.

datasets.name: ReadingBank
datasets.modality: word sequence plus coordinates in reading order

download.reason: full 500k-page set is gated (request access); ~100 sample pages are open. HF: zilongwang/ReadingBank (also GH doc-analysis/ReadingBank).

datasets.notes: Reading-order-specific (LayoutReader, EMNLP 2021). Metrics: page-level BLEU + Average Relative Distance.

datasets.name: PubTables-1M
datasets.modality: PDF pages, PASCAL-VOC bbox, table structure, word boxes

download.reason: 117 GB; enable manually. HF: bsmock/pubtables-1m; official repo + GriTS: microsoft/table-transformer.

datasets.notes: 575,305 detection pages + 947,642 structure tables. Official metric GriTS (and AP for detection).

datasets.name: PubTabNet
datasets.modality: table images plus HTML structure tokens and cell boxes (JSONL)

download.reason: 568k tables / ~12 GB; verify mirror license first. HF mirror: apoidea/pubtabnet-html; canonical: ibm-aur-nlp/PubTabNet.

datasets.notes: Origin of the TEDS metric (arXiv:1911.10683). JSONL `html` field is the table-structure ground truth.

datasets.name: FinTabNet.c
datasets.notes: 3.43 GB. Canonicalized FinTabNet for table-structure recognition (arXiv:2303.00716). GriTS/TEDS.

datasets.name: SciTSR
datasets.modality: table images plus structure from LaTeX
datasets.notes: 15,000 tables (12k/3k). Cell-adjacency-relation F1 / TEDS. Confirm repo license before commercial use.

datasets.name: DocLayNet
datasets.modality: page images plus COCO layout annotations

download.reason: large image+COCO corpus (80,863 pages). HF: docling-project/DocLayNet (the old ds4sd/DocLayNet org now redirects here).

datasets.notes: 11 layout classes, COCO bbox. Metric COCO mAP@[0.50:0.95].

datasets.name: ICDAR2023 DocLayNet
datasets.modality: page images plus COCO layout annotations
datasets.notes: ICDAR 2023 Robust Layout Segmentation in Corporate Documents.

datasets.name: CORD-v2
datasets.modality: receipt images plus JSON parse and quad boxes
datasets.notes: 1,000 receipts (800/100/100). Donut field-F1 + tree-edit-distance accuracy in the literature.

datasets.name: FUNSD
datasets.modality: scanned form images plus word boxes and entity labels
datasets.notes: 199 forms (149/50). Word bbox + NER labels + entity linking.

datasets.name: XFUND
datasets.modality: form images plus boxes and key-value links

download.reason: verify license before download. HF: rogerdehe/xfund; original: doc-analysis/XFUND.

datasets.notes: ZH, JA, ES, FR, IT, DE, PT — multilingual FUNSD.

datasets.name: Nougat (arXiv/PMC markdown GT)
datasets.modality: pipeline to build markdown/LaTeX GT (no packaged dataset)
datasets.notes: No released GT dataset; ships a LaTeXML pipeline (arXiv/PMC -> .mmd markdown) to build math/markdown GT yourself. Paper metrics: edit distance, BLEU, METEOR, F1.

datasets.name: DocBank
datasets.notes: Repo clone gives tooling/index/sample material; native token-label extraction reads words, labels, and boxes.

datasets.name: TableBank
datasets.notes: 417,234 tables. GitHub download is gated behind a request form; HF mirror liminghao1630/TableBank is relicensed Apache-2.0.

datasets.name: SROIE
datasets.notes: 1,000 receipts. Official source is the ICDAR RRC portal; mirror license unverified for redistribution.

datasets.name: ckorzen benchmark
datasets.task: PDF text extraction and reading order
datasets.modality: scientific PDFs plus text extraction targets
datasets.notes: Good native text, order, paragraph, and role benchmark; bundled text/HTML and feature-box TSV exercise non-PDF fallback extraction.
